review.assessment: The change replaces `src/lib.rs` but retains the exact same O(N·K) nested-loop logic described in the prompt as the performance bottleneck, failing to implement any algorithmic optimization. While it successfully compiles and passes the provided unit test, it completely ignores the explicit requirement for roughly linear time complexity on large inputs with a large window `k`. Consequently, the code remains unacceptably slow for its intended use case.
